static_traits.name: 周珊
static_traits.family_status: 与祖父母同住，养一只猫
static_traits.social_status: Supportive relationships with grandparents, but the relationship with grandmother was affected by the pizza incident, and hesitant about expressing feelings
static_traits.medical_history: without显著身体疾病；既往not yet接受心理治疗；not yet有类似心理问题经历
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude，能清晰表达Anxiety与内疚；其他Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我在与奶奶一起做披萨时把披萨烤糊后，出现内疚与自我not足感，担心她not再愿意与我一起做饭，这让我很痛苦。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望缓解内疚与Being rejected的恐惧，这些已影响情绪与日常生活，并避免事态进一步恶化。

special_situations.event: 与奶奶一起做披萨时把披萨烤糊了
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我犯错，家人会失望并not再愿意与我合作或相处；犯错意味着I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避在厨房活动，暂not与奶奶一起做饭
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她再也not会和我一起做饭了

special_situations.event: 每次想到与奶奶一起做饭
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再次下厨，必定还会失败，这说明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免Entering the kitchen或参与烹饪情境

special_situations.event: 想到要与奶奶谈论自己的感受
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express true feelings, she will confirm she is disappointed in me and reject me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 保持沉默，回避与奶奶沟通

special_situations.event: 回想过去几次做饭失误时奶奶曾经很理解
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视以往的理解与支持，只关注负面可能

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted by grandmother, and to be seen and recognized in close family interactions (cooking together)
defense_goal: 通过回避厨房与沟通来保持距离，以避免遭遇negate与拒绝

object_relations.self_representation: 内疚、容易犯错的、not够好的孙辈
object_relations.object_representation: 可能失望并会拒绝我的奶奶

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether the event and one's feelings have been discussed with grandmother
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client believes that speaking up to communicate will make grandmother confirm that oneself has disappointed her, and thus reject oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和、验证情感的语气，减少对抗与质疑；以开放式问题邀请其逐步表达具体感受与需要，允许停顿并给出安全边界。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to cook with grandmother again and do a behavioral experiment
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client believes cooking again will inevitably fail and will disappoint her grandmother even more
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 先Empathy其紧张与担忧，再引导其区分“假设”与“证据”；采用小步推进与具体化任务，鼓励记录实际反应以修正Anticipation。

manifestations: 担心被奶奶拒绝而not再一起做饭
犹豫表达感受、保持距离
因一次失误而自我价值动摇，体验“not够好”与内疚

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: not敢与奶奶谈论自己的内疚与担忧
回避在厨房和参与做饭

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 将自身的Self-denial与恐惧归因于奶奶“会失望/会拒绝我”
读心式假设奶奶持有负面评价

exception_events.target_problem: 在想到与奶奶一起做饭的情境时，来访者通常会产生强烈的Anxiety与内疚，预测Being rejected，并选择回避。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 以往几次做饭出现失误时，奶奶表现出理解与包容，have not责备或拒绝，互动保持温和。
exception_events.reason: not同支持：奶奶一贯的理解与支持；not同证据：过往失误并not yet导致拒绝，为当前担忧提供反例。

positive_force: 奶奶在以往失误时表现出理解与包容
愿意尝试行为实验并寻求咨询帮助
能够觉察并描述自己的自动化思维
negative_force: 读心术与预测not yet来的思维模式
对Being rejected的强烈恐惧与外部验证依赖

target_behavior.behavior: 回避Entering the kitchen及与奶奶一起做饭
antecedent: 被邀请或计划与奶奶再下厨
target_behavior.core_reason: 因一次失誤引发的Being rejected恐惧，将事件过度概括为“自己not够好”的证据，并以读心与预测not yet来的方式放大负面结果。
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的negate与拒绝，短时降低Anxiety与压力
target_behavior.consequence: 家庭互动减少、Relationship tension与疏离；Persistent anxiety与内疚，影响日常活动

target_behavior.behavior: 犹豫/回避与奶奶沟通自己的感受
antecedent: Being asked about, or thinking about, discussing the pizza incident and one's feelings with grandmother
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心沟通会确认对方失望（读心术），由此加剧Being rejected的恐惧
target_behavior.function: 避免面对可能的负面反馈以降低当下not适
target_behavior.consequence: 情绪without法缓解，误解与疏离加深
